card.text: Hot Jupiter whose heat map JWST measured from its eclipses.

sources.label: Challener et al. 2024
sources.quote: We present two-dimensional near-infrared temperature maps of the canonical hot Jupiter WASP-43b

introduction.text: WASP-43b is a gas giant that circles its star in 19.5 hours, always showing it the same face. Its dayside peaks near 2,000 K.

temperature.title: JWST eclipse map
temperature.summary: How hot each part of the planet is, fitted to JWST light curves as the planet turned and slipped behind its star.
